abstract: Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a bounded Kleinian circle packing with symmetry group $\Gamma$, and let $N_{\mathcal{P}}(T)$ denote the number of circles in $\mathcal{P}$ of radius at least $T^{-1}$. We obtain an asymptotic formula for $N_{\mathcal{P}}(T)$ in which the eigenvalues of the Laplace operator below the continuous spectrum contribute a finite sum of main terms, with an error term having the same exponent as in the counting theorem of Lax--Phillips for $\Gamma$-orbits in $\mathbb H^3$.
hook: Circles in a Kleinian circle packing are counted with main terms from Laplacian eigenvalues.
summary: The paper gives an asymptotic count of circles above a given size in a bounded Kleinian packing. Eigenvalues of the Laplace operator below the continuous spectrum each add a main term, and the error exponent matches the Lax-Phillips orbit-counting theorem. It is a technical result for specialists in a narrow class of packings.
title: Counting circles in Kleinian circle packings
